[2026-09-01T20:40:43.353Z] [world] The flat silt heaves, and a hand breaks the surface, then an arm, then a face caked grey with a thousand years of it.
[2026-09-01T20:40:43.353Z] [arbiter] You've heard of these on the road: the Aetherkin, the ones the mud drowned and the Aether raised back up.
[2026-09-01T20:40:43.353Z] [world] In life it was a machinist, one hand fused half-around a wrench that rusted into the bone — the mud takes faces first, so the rest is a guess and a kindness. Something you stirred woke the Aetherstone that held them; now they're awake and out.
[2026-09-01T20:40:43.353Z] [world] It doesn't lunge. It cringes back, arms up over its face — remembering, dimly, that living things once meant harm. It will only fight if you make it.
[2026-09-01T20:40:43.354Z] [world] You walk east through open silt. The compass tells you The Buried Cities lies further east — 7 tiles, about 18 hours of travel.
[2026-09-01T20:40:43.354Z] [world] Some part of you has been keeping the place bookmarked.

[2026-09-01T20:40:50.021Z] [world] Nell of the Long Road sets down what they're holding. "Didn't expect you today, Cheddar Bob."

[2026-09-01T20:40:50.021Z] [world] A stall has been thrown up on the next stretch of ground — Nell of the Long Road, wandering trader. Tap the vendor banner to trade.
[2026-09-01T20:40:50.033Z] [world] Rare workings for sale: Aetheric Vest (200 TC) — buy one by name to learn it. This one also mends worn gear, trains a stat for coin, and patches up a hurt dog or golem — just ask.
[2026-09-01T20:40:50.034Z] [world] You walk east through open silt. The compass tells you The Buried Cities lies further east — 6 tiles, about 15 hours of travel.
[2026-09-01T20:40:50.038Z] [world] A small low door at the base of one of the Obsidian Pillars, polished smooth by centuries of magnetic wind. Inside, the observatory's main chamber: a great brass armillary the size of a wagon, still tur
ning slowly under its own weight, charting skies that no longer exist as charted. The air bends compass needles and turns pocket watches into ornaments. A pre-flood Sentinel-class drone still patrols the inner ring, its servos starved but functional.
[2026-09-01T20:40:50.038Z] [world] A logbook on the central desk records, in careful hand: 'Day 1,847 since the surface stopped answering. The sky charts still match. We have stopped checking.'
